subject: TrialCorp bakeoff: proposed credit allocation & audit plan
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@trialcorp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@trialcorp.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Redwood inclusion in next-week bakeoff (credits + evidence ask)

Hi Sean,

We're finalizing the evaluation slate for our enterprise search RFP and want Redwood to be part of a head-to-head next week. Two asks from procurement and the engineering review team: a) can you provide an audit-ready credit allocation for a side-by-side bench (we're looking at token-based usage) and b) confirm you can provide machine-readable usage exports and short-term access to audit logs/SOC2 evidence during the test window.

Timeline: kickoff on Monday 11/15, 10 business days of active testing. Because one vendor had some onboarding delays, would Redwood be open to a 2-week trial extension if we agree to a longer evaluation window?

I've attached the bakeoff scope (TrialCorp_Bakeoff_RFP.pdf) for context. Procurement (cc) will handle contract/PO questions.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Ramos
Head of Integrations | TrialCorp
attachments: TrialCorp_Bakeoff_RFP.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@trialcorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood inclusion in next-week bakeoff (credits + evidence ask)

Hi Alicia — great to hear from you and thanks for the scope doc.

Short answers up front: yes on both. We can:
- Provide a time-limited token credit allocation for the bakeoff; proposed initial allocation: 250,000 tokens (can be bumped after quick ops review).
- Offer machine-readable exports (CSV/JSON) at the evaluation cadence and a temporary view of audit logs relevant to the test. We can also surface per-route latency/cost dashboards for your engineering reviewers.

Two operational notes:
1) We typically host the credits as an escrowed trial bucket tied to the HubSpot deal and require a simple SOW amendment for auditing and billing guardrails.
2) For a 2-week extension we would want to formalize acceptance criteria (pass/fail signals) so both sides align on post-bakeoff next steps.

Attaching a draft SOW and a credit allocation sheet for your procurement team: TrialCorp_Bakeoff_SOW_v1.pdf, Credit_Allocation_Sheet.xlsx. Can procurement confirm whether Net30 or PO is preferred so legal/finance route accordingly?

Looping in Ben (rev ops) and Kim (legal) to expedite approvals; Ben — can we approve 250k tokens and a two-week extension scoped as an addendum to our standard eval terms?

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments: TrialCorp_Bakeoff_SOW_v1.pdf; Credit_Allocation_Sheet.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood inclusion in next-week bakeoff (credits + evidence ask)

Sean — thanks for the heads-up. Internal approval notes:
- Finance/RevOps are OK to provision an escrowed trial credit of up to 275,000 tokens for TrialCorp; recommend we split as 200k for core eval and 75k reserved for follow-on edge cases.
- Legal (Kim) — please confirm the SOW addendum language on audit access (time-limited, read-only) is acceptable. We should avoid broad log retention guarantees beyond the test window.
- Ops ask: attach usage caps and throttling defaults to prevent noisy tests from consuming the bucket in <24h. Ops will add rate-limits and a single alerting threshold.

If legal signs off, I'm comfortable greenlighting the credit. Marissa, flag for potential promo allocation if TrialCorp converts within 90 days.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Procurement <procure@trialcorp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@trialcorp.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood inclusion in next-week bakeoff (credits + evidence ask)

Sean / Alicia — procurement here. Quick items we need before kickoff:
- Official quote or invoice line for the trial credit (we prefer to have a PO on file).
- Redline of the SOW addendum (please send via DocuSign when ready).
- Confirmation of token unit definition (how many tokens per request/response) and an explicit throttle policy (ops caps).
- Compliance checklist: SOC2 report link and the short CSV export format. If you can provide a temporary read-only link to the SOC2 summary and the last three months of relevant audit logs, that will speed our internal approvals.

Our payment terms are Net30 by default. Please advise if Redwood needs a different arrangement for a trial escrow.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
TrialCorp
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@trialcorp.com>, Procurement <procure@trialcorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood inclusion in next-week bakeoff (credits + evidence ask)

Thanks — all good. Summary and next steps from Redwood:
- Approved credit allocation: 275,000 tokens (200k core + 75k buffer). Credits will be provisioned to an escrowed evaluation bucket tied to deal TRIAL-4592.
- Trial extension: we approve a 2-week extension to your testing window as an addendum to the SOW.
- Audit & compliance: attached is a read-only SOC2 summary and we will provide machine-readable usage exports in CSV/JSON daily during the active window. We will not export full system logs beyond the scoped artifacts in the SOW (standard data minimization).
- Throttling & caps: ops will enforce a default per-minute token cap and an alert at 80% consumption; we'll share the exact rate-limit values in the Ops note.
- Billing/PO: Net30 is acceptable — we'll invoice post-bakeoff for any overage beyond the allocated credits. No upfront payment required to provision the escrowed bucket.

Attachments: TrialCorp_Bakeoff_SOW_v1.pdf; Credit_Allocation_Sheet.xlsx; redwood-eval-terms.docx
DocuSign: https://docusign.net/envelope/XYZ123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4592

Alicia/Procurement — can you confirm PO issuance by Thu 11/14 so we can provision credits ahead of your kickoff? If you send the redlined SOW, Kim will review same day and loop legal for a quick sign.

Best regards,
Sean Gallagher
